notes:
— Account background: midwestern direct-to-consumer retailer, heavy seasonal peaks (Black Friday / Holiday window). Catalog size ~ 12M SKUs (global variants), expect ~50M embeddings after feature expansion. Current search: hybrid keyword + rules; experimenting with RAG + embedding-based reranking to reduce irrelevant top results and lift AOV.

— Initial requirements (from CTO + Search PM):
  • P99 latency target for product search rerank: <= 120ms (interactive UX).
  • Sustained baseline QPS: 150 qps, spike capacity: 1200 qps for 6–12 hours during peak events.
  • Cost sensitivity: target end-to-end cost-per-query (embedding + rerank) <= $0.004 at baseline; acceptable up to $0.01 during spikes if latency/SLO met.
  • Indexing cadence: nightly full refresh + intra-day delta for price/availability.
  • Re-ranking model: candidate generation from existing BM25 + semantic recall (embeddings) then lightweight reranker to combine business signals (inventory, margin).

— Technical notes from discovery calls:
  • Prefer VPC/private deployment for PII/ad tracking controls and residency obligations in US only.
  • Need to validate embedding consistency across model versions — desire "stable embeddings" or migration tooling.
  • Looking for quantization guidance and model recommendations for cost (4-bit Q options discussed).
  • Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching policy, KV caching for popular prefixes, and smart routing to lower-cost model variants during off-peak.

— POC plan agreed:
  1) Ingest 2M representative SKUs + 3 months of query logs; build embedding index and baseline latency/cost metrics.
  2) Run A/B comparing current ranking vs. embedding+rerank; measure CTR, AOV, and median/p99 latencies.
  3) Tune batching & cache settings; test dedicated pool sizing for 150 qps and simulated 1200 qps spike.
